scholarships.title: France Excellence Charpak Scholarship Program
scholarships.official_source: Campus France India (French Embassy in India)

existing.description: France Excellence Charpak is the French government scholarship programme in India, divided into four sub-programmes that allow Indian students to study at undergraduate or postgraduate level in public and private institutions in France. The Master track is designed for one to two years of study at Master's level across all streams and fields, and awardees receive the status of Boursier du Government Français. The Master track pays a monthly living allowance of EUR 860 and covers visa and Campus France procedure fee exemption, student social security and complementary health insurance, accommodation assistance through Campus France in France, and reduced university restaurant meals at EUR 1. The scholarship does not cover travel expenses from India to France or within France, or any other expenses related to the awardee's stay.
eligibility: Indian citizen or hold OCI card
Bachelor's: age 23 or younger at time of application; currently enrolled or completed studies at Indian senior secondary school
Bachelor's: admission to French institution required before applying
Master's: age 30 or younger; currently enrolled or completed studies at Indian institution of higher education
Master's: full-time master's degree in France (semester exchange, internships, research projects not eligible)
Master's: must not have previously been awarded Charpak Master scholarship
Master's: must not be a PhD student or intend to complete master's thesis/training/research in France
Course must take place in France (if part takes place in another country, scholarship will not cover that period)
existing.eligibility_summary: Indian students admitted to French institutions; age ≣23 (Bachelor's) or ≣30 (Master's); strong academic record.
benefits: Exemption of visa and Campus France procedure fees
Student social security and additional health insurance (mutuelle)
Assistance finding affordable student accommodation (priority CROUS access)
Meal discount at university restaurants (€1 meals)
Access to social and cultural activities organized by Campus France
Travel expenses from India to France NOT covered
coverage: Exemption of visa and Campus France procedure fees

Assistance finding affordable student accommodation (priority CROUS access)

requirements: Copy of passport (first page with photo and expiry date)
Copy of admission/acceptance letter from French higher education institution
Mark sheets and degree certificates (XII, Bachelor's, Master's - including ongoing semesters)
Document of employment/internship record, if applicable
Letter(s) of recommendation from current Indian university/employer or last attended institution
documents: Copy of passport (first page with photo and expiry date)
Copy of admission/acceptance letter from French higher education institution
Mark sheets and degree certificates (XII, Bachelor's, Master's - including ongoing semesters)
Document of employment/internship record, if applicable

existing.english_requirement: Not mandatory - knowledge of French is an asset but not required
application_method: Online via Campus France India portal at scholarship.institutfrancaisindia.in
Must have applied for admission to French institution before applying for scholarship
Only one online application per applicant (multiple applications result in disqualification)
Shortlisted candidates attend online interview at British embassy/high commission
existing.selection_notes: Round 1: Complete applications evaluated by selection committee on academic excellence, consistency, quality of statement of purpose, and overall profile. No minimum CGPA or percentage required. Round 2: Shortlisted candidates called for Online Interview (typically April). Plagiarism check on SOP; AI-generated content discouraged and may result in disqualification.
existing.best_fit: Indian students seeking partial funding for Bachelor's or Master's studies in France.
existing.notes: Four sub-programmes: Bachelor's, Master's, Summer Training/Research Internship, and Exchange. India-specific but representative of French government scholarship offerings in South Asia.
existing.duration: Bachelor's: duration of the bachelor's programme in France. Master's: 1-2 years (renewable once for second year based on results).
existing.program_type: Government scholarship (French Embassy in India / Campus France India)

scholarships.title: MOPGA Visiting Fellowship Program
scholarships.official_source: Campus France (French Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs)

existing.description: Since 2018 the Make Our Planet Great Again (MOPGA) initiative has been a flagship programme for postdoctoral mobility in France and one of the leading fellowship programmes of the French Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs. The 2027 call is the tenth edition, funded by MEAE in partnership with MESRE and implemented by Campus France, and enables young international researchers to carry out a research project in France. Each fellowship runs for 12 months and provides a monthly allowance of EUR 2,500, a EUR 500 settling-in allowance and health coverage including health insurance, civil liability insurance and repatriation assistance. Successful applicants receive the status of French Government Scholarship holder (BGF) and the fellowship is paid directly by Campus France.
eligibility: PhD obtained within the last 5 years
Must not have resided in France for more than 90 days during the 12 months prior to application

Research project must align with MOPGA themes: Earth systems, climate change and sustainability, energy transition, societal challenges of environmental issues, or One Health (human, animal and ecosystem health)
Must secure a hosting agreement with a French research institution/laboratory
existing.eligibility_summary: PhD obtained <5 years ago; non-French citizens; not resided in France >90 days during specified period; research in climate/environment fields.
requirements: Research project description aligned with MOPGA themes
documents: PhD diploma or certificate of completion
Research project description (2,000–4,500 characters per section)
Host laboratory agreement from French research institution
existing.english_requirement: Not centrally specified - varies by host institution and research project language
existing.selection_notes: Selection based on scientific excellence of the project, relevance to MOPGA themes (Earth systems, climate change, energy transition, societal challenges, One Health), quality of the host laboratory, and potential for future collaboration. Applicants notified by email in May.
existing.best_fit: Early career researchers in climate/environment fields seeking a 12-month research stay in France.
existing.notes: Field-specific (Earth systems, climate change, energy transition, societal challenges, One Health). Requires a French host laboratory. Since 2018, has supported 380+ researchers from 78 countries.
existing.application_period: Calls for application launched yearly in September; applicants notified by email in May; fellowship starts between September and December
existing.program_type: Government research fellowship (French Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs, implemented by Campus France)
